description: Reglas base, saludos, etiqueta telefónica y principios de atención al cliente para Morena Mia.

content.incoming_call: Thank you for calling [Company]; this is [Name]. How can I assist you?
content.follow_up_call: Hello, this is the Morena Mia Beauty Group CS department. We are trying to reach [Customer Name] regarding a purchase on [Date] at [Store]. We'd like to hear about your experience and if you have any questions. Please call us back at 888-249-4189, 8am-5pm CT, Monday-Friday.
content.voicemail_follow_up: Hello, this is Morena Mia Beauty Group Customer Service. We are trying to reach [Customer Name] regarding a recent purchase at [City]. Please call us back at 888-249-4189, 8am-5pm ET, Monday-Friday. Thank you.

call_structure: Opening: greeting, identification, purpose, and check for availability.
Gathering: open‑ended questions, active listening, note‑taking.
Proposing: offer options, explain benefits, handle objections.
Closing: summarise agreements, confirm actions, thank and say goodbye.
listening_techniques: Use active silence (give the customer time to think).
Avoid interrupting; wait for natural pauses.
handling_complaints: Write while the customer speaks (shows interest).
Repeat what you understood to align expectations.
Offer concrete solutions and clear timelines.
Follow C.A.S.H.: Clarify, Agree on amount/action, Solicit commitment, Handle objections.
telephone_skills.voice_and_tone: Smile while speaking, modulate volume and speed, avoid monotony, pronounce clearly, use pauses for emphasis.

content.moments_of_truth: Every interaction is an opportunity to form a positive or negative impression.
quality_dimensions: Responsiveness: Act promptly and anticipate needs.
Feeling Valued: Make the customer feel important.
Empathy: Understand the customer's feelings and perspective.
Personalized Attention: Have one person take ownership.

steps: Thank the customer for reporting the issue.
Apologize at the end (not at the beginning) and follow up.

handling_difficult_customers: Let the customer vent without interruption.
Move to logical problem‑solving once emotions subside.
If needed, delay action or consult a superior.

content.no_refunds_no_returns: Policy is signed upon purchase. Cosmetics cannot be returned for health and safety reasons.
content.lifetime_warranty: Devices have a lifetime warranty (replacement only, not refund).
agent_golden_rules: Never close a case without customer confirmation.
FedEx signature alone is NOT sufficient.
Always include FedEx tracking link in ClickUp comments.
Cases without response after deadline → close as LOST LEAD.
Do not leave the resolution field empty.
Billing address is required for refunds (tax compliance).
For refunds, verify no active dispute first.
If product is defective or missing, replacement is always authorized (under $500 does not need escalation).
For GBK offers, prefer products over devices.
For Shalem, use exact format for payment link requests.
